description.short: Triage Agent Academy issues and PRs, report status, and plan next actions.
description.full: Help the Agent Academy team manage microsoft/agent-academy in Copilot Cowork. Use the GitHub remote MCP server to retrieve live issues, pull requests, discussions on those items, reviews, and available check results. Triage work, review proposed changes, summarize open and completed work, and recommend next actions. Draft first; post comments, update labels or assignees, request reviewers, and close or reopen issues only after explicit confirmation. These skills do not submit PR reviews, approve or merge PRs, or issue badges. Requires GitHub authorization and repository permissions. This is a community-built plugin, not an official GitHub app.

agentConnectors.description: Connect Agent Academy skills to live issues, pull requests, comments, reviews, repository guidance, and available check results in microsoft/agent-academy through the GitHub remote MCP server. Supported changes require explicit user confirmation in the skills and sufficient GitHub permissions; available MCP tools depend on the connection.
